title: Revocation
description: One device taking another off the link, written under the revoked device's id (furlough.revoke.<id>) so that device finds it on its next read and un-enrols itself. Any linked device may write one; every other device leaves the revoked device out of the roster immediately.

at.description: When it was written. A revocation older than the entry's enrolledAt is spent rather than deleted, so a device can come back.
